what: Matched-config re-measurement of gate-1 DRBPushSharePct, superseding ADR-0088's headline 12.37%.
READ_THIS_FIRST: The per-run artifact JSON this test writes has NO era/corpus field (backlog J26). Corpus and era are recorded HERE, out-of-band. Do not cite a bare per-run artifact without its corpus.

config.seed_block_note: runs=4 consumes seed..seed+3; blocks MUST be spaced >=4 apart. A first replication at 20240602/03/04 overlapped the baseline block by 3/2/1 draws and was DISCARDED.

matched_98zip.corpus: recent-era 05-08 MINUS the two 07-08 zips added after the ADR-0088 publish moment (07-08_27_reg-sim16.zip, 07-08_28_reg-sim17.zip)
matched_98zip.corpus_provenance: VERIFIED not inferred: find -newermt '2026-07-21 10:28:42' AND the -newerct variant each return exactly those two zips; ctime agreeing rules out an in-place rewrite with preserved mtime.
matched_98zip.purpose: Config-matched to ADR-0088 (which also saw 97 snapshots) so the delta is a pure engine delta.

current_100zip.CITE_THIS: paired_estimate_pct (12.4277). The raw mean 12.4361 is biased HIGH: this arm ran only blocks 01/05/09/13, whose matched mean is +0.0065pp above the 7-block matched mean. The paired delta's SD is 0.00031 (~70x tighter than the seed SD), so the paired estimator is strictly more precise than extending this arm to its own n=7.

verdict.detail: Matched-config mean 12.4142 is -0.0058pp (-0.73 SE) below 12.42 and -0.0074pp (-0.94 SE) below 12.4216; 3 of 7 and 2 of 7 blocks respectively sit above. The current-corpus paired estimate 12.4277 is +0.77 SE above 12.4216. Every estimate is within +/-1 SE of the floor and the matched point estimate is BELOW it.
verdict.consequence: Cut-over HOLD stands. ADR-0094 Verdict B untouched. No new ADR warranted for a non-event.
verdict.engine_did_move: Yes: 12.3652 (0df86dbdc) -> 12.4142 (77b9be48b) = +0.0490pp, attributed by bisect to the faithful ports above.
verdict.refutes: Backlog J24's prior 'direction is below 12.37, further from GO' claim. Its 11.81% (stride 8) and ~12.27% (stride 100) readings were ALL-ERA subsamples (720/8=87 and 720/100=8 snapshots), never band-comparable to a recent-era floor. The engine moved UP.

seed_sd_correction.phase6_overlap_confirmed: 2026-07-24 (PR #1622). CONFIRMED: Phase 6 swept seeds 20240601-08 at the default runs=4 (artifact header 'stride=8 runs=4'), so adjacent blocks share 3 of 4 draws — 8 readings are a sliding 4-wide window over only 11 distinct draws. Two compounding understatements: the ADR quoted the population SD 0.01189 rather than the sample SD 0.01271, and overlapping 4-windows deflate the sample SD x0.781 vs disjoint blocks (400k-trial MC). De-overlapped: 0.01271 / 0.781 = 0.016. ADR-0094 carries a correcting Addendum; both its verdicts stand.
seed_sd_correction.guidance: Use 0.021 as the gate-1 noise floor. Do NOT merge 0.016 and 0.021 — 0.016 is the corrected all-era/stride-8 Phase 6 figure, 0.021 is this matched recent-era/stride-1 measurement; different estimands. For recent-era gate-1 arithmetic use 0.021.
